title: Survey Response Generation: Generating Closed-Ended Survey Responses In-Silico with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the robustness of model outputs against prompt perturbations by presenting response options in different formats (full text versus indexed, e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C') and comparing the generated responses when the options are presented in their original sequence versus a reversed order to detect positional preferences like A-bias.
